entries.title: Isaiah 35:1
segments: ¶The wilderness and the wasteland shall be glad for them, And the desert shall rejoice and blossom as the rose;

entries.title: Isaiah 35:2
segments: It shall blossom abundantly and rejoice, Even with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon shall be given to it, The excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They shall see the glory of the LORD, The excellency of our God.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:3
segments: Strengthen the weak hands, And make firm the feeble knees.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:4
segments: Say to those [who are] fearful-hearted, "Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come [with] vengeance, [With] the recompense of God; He will come and save you."

entries.title: Isaiah 35:5
segments: ¶Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, And the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:6
segments: Then the lame shall leap like a deer, And the tongue of the dumb sing. For waters shall burst forth in the wilderness, And streams in the desert.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:7
segments: The parched ground shall become a pool, And the thirsty land springs of water; In the habitation of jackals, where each lay, [There shall be] grass with reeds and rushes.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:8
segments: A highway shall be there, and a road, And it shall be called the Highway of Holiness. The unclean shall not pass over it, But it [shall be] for others. Whoever walks the road, although a fool, Shall not go astray.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:9
segments: No lion shall be there, Nor shall [any] ravenous beast go up on it; It shall not be found there. But the redeemed shall walk [there],

entries.title: Isaiah 35:10
segments: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, And come to Zion with singing, With everlasting joy on their heads. They shall obtain joy and gladness, And sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
